purpose: An editable operator commissioning record around actual selected systems and original exports.

representation.ids: Stable ordinary identifiers, unique within a record type; references resolve within the selected business.
representation.money: Integer minor units plus currency; null means unknown, zero is an entered value.
representation.time: Preserve source text/offset and organization IANA time zone; canonical instants only when resolvable.
representation.durations: Integer minutes or null, with source and any explicit correction retained.
representation.percent: Exact decimal string or integer basis points as chosen by implementation; never binary-floating rounding of pay.
representation.unknowns: Use null/pending and a visible label; do not coerce absent values to false, zero or accepted.
representation.files: Original bytes, filename, media type, byte length and SHA256; attachment references are exact identities.
representation.externalActions: Desk records requested/performed/observed events. No implicit vendor account, payroll, messaging, cancellation or deletion action.

rules: Selected scope is one business.
Empty starter has no invented operating values.
Keep original bytes immutable; changed bytes create a new edition.
Do not store passwords or property entry secrets in a portable review packet.
Map customer/property/job/visit/worker separately.
All original rows belong to accepted/excluded/unresolved dispositions.
Changed map invalidates its selected acceptance.
Secure access reference records custody, not the secret.
Client packet requires explicit field/attachment selection.
Requested and observed results remain separate.
A single-visit result must identify observed surrounding occurrences.
Keep excluded future/history records available in the original source.
Missing clock-out is unresolved, not an invented completed shift.
Corrections retain superseded values and source.
Do not infer earnings from an absent time field.
Provider approval and desk review are distinct fields.
Use actual original calculations and separate reviewer differences.
No tax, net-pay or payment execution is implied.
Changing the selected original edition requires a new review.
Only present when selected and capability is observed.
Keep original invoice and inspection rather than generating assumed native results.
Unmeasured stays null.
Compare equivalent scope and observation windows.
Selected edits require new review; preserve historical decisions.
Each condition has owner, desired result and next review date.
Cancellation, export and deletion are separate events.
Do not assume complete attachment/message export from CSV availability.

requirements: Append full ordered actions with previous revision and returned revision.
Reconstruct current state from history on receiving, including preserved original sources and decisions.
Reject stale writes without changing the current workspace.
Preserve raw imported originals through export and independent reopen.
Show whether browser persistence succeeded; provide complete working download in session mode.

unknowns: Detailed vendor role matrix and account-specific permissions
Exact recurrence horizon and customer-specific calendar behavior
Exact CSV header spelling, dialect and import requirements of each chosen payroll provider
Overtime, taxes, net-pay and jurisdiction-specific interpretation
Actual selected subscription, locations, integrations and ownership
Customer-specific cancellation/no-show policy and agreed charge authorization
